title: Malayani- That which doesn't concern you
body:
‘Malayani’ means, ‘that which doesn’t concern you’. You must not speak of or act on that which doesn’t
concern you. If a man takes care of his speech, keeping his tongue, Allah Almighty gives Divine Wisdom to his
tongue so that he speaks only truth and righteousness. To speak of that which doesn’t concern you makes
your Iman weak. When you leave this bad habit, your faith becomes stronger. You cannot know what
concerns you or not, save through your inspirations. Then you may know very well what is yours or not.
01.04.1999
